title: geranium × lateripes
intro: Geranium × lateripes, commonly known as the cross-pollinated geranium, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the family Geraniaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress, anxiety, and inflammation, as well as promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Geranium × lateripes are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include geraniol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, that have been shown to exhibit sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Geranium × lateripes may also contribute to its potential in reducing pain and improving mood.
